body: **Blocked at claim (orchestrator, 2026-10-03):** `claim_ticket` refuses every model with `unsupported_capability`: "Host lacks required tool network". The ticket needs `network` to `npm install @vitest/coverage-v8`, which isn't installed. This host does have network access. The catalog registered at run start (`hc_01m41qcahn2x6v12m1kc1w4kj1`) simply left `network` out, which was my mistake. A run's catalog is fixed by `start_run` and no tool rebinds it, so registering a corrected catalog doesn't help this run. I am not claiming without a `modelId` to skip the check, because that would hide which model does the work. Waiting on the person's decision. DM-29 gates DM-33 and everything after it.
